screenshot_reconciliation.reason: The user references a long screenshot, but no image payload or repository path is available to the tools in this run. The user's prose is a discovery lead, not pixel-level evidence, and no OCR result is promoted to fact.
modules_discovered_from_user_description: Fantasy team or player-card selection area
tier_1_reconciliation: The apparent player-card area is the TI2026 Fantasy War Banner interface; Tier-1 strings establish that the actual choice unit is a team for each role.
The apparent stat list is the 18-stat Emblem Stats table, partitioned into six red, six blue, and six green stats.

The other prediction area can only be the 16-slot Group Stage page or the 14-slot main-event bracket: the league-19719 definition exhaustively enumerates those 30 out-of-game slots, and explicitly sets in-game prediction count to zero.
